Existing original headtilt/round-open monochromeeyes/whiteglints/O-mouth, imageRIGHT raised curledhand and imageLEFT waistside finger/cuff, full skirt/liftedrearleg/forwardleg/shoes, 2beads/2capleaves and fixedLEFT-imageRIGHT root remain good historical action/costume evidence. Mint is muted with broad graymain, no new specular glare. However complete visible lock reads as closely filled gray/mint conical/candy spiral with internal gray-green material strips throughout, no discernible returning hollow axis or exposed air. R14 supplies compact downward motion only, not proof of solid material. Cannot auto-retain prior construction just because compressed; redraw visible lock as continuous broad gray ribbon with real returns/air wherever exposed, preserving original shoulder occlusion and without forcing a fixed hole count or hidden tail. Do not overwrite old report; this latest-policy repair supersedes only current selection, not historical artistic evidence. No new render, dynamic or user acceptance.
